name: validity
description: Finding validity: confirmed means the claim is real; false_positive means the claim is wrong; not_affected means a real issue does not apply to this repository, version or deployment. Historical values remain readable.
note: Canonical decision validity is confirmed, false_positive or not_affected. Finding.kind separately distinguishes vulnerability from weakness. Null on a decision means no answer.

definitions.corrected: Historical revision marker; the owner imports it as a restatement rather than a validity answer.
definitions.not_verified: Historical audit-stage absence of a validity answer.
definitions.hardening: Historical real defense-in-depth weakness; read as confirmed validity and finding_kind weakness.
definitions.not_affected: The issue exists but does not apply to this repository, version or deployment.
definitions.true_positive: Historical decision spelling of confirmed; remains a current triage verdict in the verdict vocabulary.

corrected.note: A restatement is an operation handled by the decision owner, not an unconditional validity replacement.

not_verified.note: Import as no validity answer; never invent a confirmed decision.
